label: Observation and law taxonomy
title: When does a description acquire its own rule?
summary: A maintained map of same-rule Groovy disagreement, intrinsic observer closure, effective laws, completion-dependent recursion, external schedules and observation-controlled rule choice.
takeaway: G tests one choice of observer and effective rule. A law for an observation may differ from the source rule, and feeding that law back creates a new system whose controller must be counted.
